summary: DestProfilePrfRequirements is a user control for managing prerequisite requirements. It allows users to add, edit, filter, and validate requirements associated with a destination profile. The control supports multiple requirement types: standard, document upload, and web link. Sub-disciplines can be restricted and managed using included/excluded lists. The interface is dynamic, supporting editable and read-only modes, and supports sectioning/grouping of requirements by logical sections.
purpose: To facilitate the addition, editing, validation, and management of prerequisite requirements (including type, description, associated documents, web links, sub-disciplines, and logical sections) within a destination profile context.

workflows.name: Add/Edit Requirement
steps: User clicks Add or Edit for a requirement.
FormView is displayed in Insert or Edit mode.
User selects requirement type (Standard, Document, or Link).
If Document, a file is uploaded and stored in a generated folder.
If Link, a URL is entered.
User fills in requirement fields (description, section, optional website, document name).
If sub-disciplines are enabled, user selects disciplines included/excluded.
On save, requirement is added/updated via stored procedure.
FormView is hidden, and the list/grid is refreshed.

workflows.name: Filter Requirements
steps: User selects requirement or discipline filter.
System filters and displays requirements based on selection.

workflows.name: Delete Requirement
steps: Grid is refreshed to remove the deleted entry.

business_rules: If all disciplines are included, sub-discipline selection is disabled.
Only valid (UUID-format) document IDs are considered when linking entities.
Section names are used for logical grouping; empty sections are treated as no section.
validations: File upload presence and file type validation for document requirements.
If no sub-disciplines are included (when required), user is notified and all will be allowed.
calculations: None explicit, but list building for included/excluded sub-disciplines.
conditions: If UseSubDisciplines is enabled, display sub-discipline chooser.
If PrerequisiteOption is Document, file upload and document name fields are shown.
If PrerequisiteOption is Link, website URL field is shown.
If PrerequisiteOption is Standard, description only.
system_behavior: Initializes and binds dropdowns and lists on page load.
Dynamically updates UI based on selected requirement type.
Populates dropdowns with codes, omitting certain types if configured.
Stores and retrieves user session state (e.g., last filter applied, first load).
Handles add/edit/delete with backend stored procedures.
dependencies: User session for permissions and allowed disciplines.
Codes data for populating requirement types.
Server file system for document storage.
exceptions: If file upload fails, returns false and does not save requirement.
If user session is invalid, cancels data operations.
If code/discipline data is missing or malformed, may suppress or alter controls.
content_gaps: Details on field types and constraints (e.g., max lengths, allowed file types) are inferred, not explicit.
No explicit error messages or user feedback details are present.
Business context and downstream integrations are not described.
